# OpenProgram 0.6.0 Release Notes

Release date: July 21, 2026. This version introduced the Desktop shell, multi-window compound tabs, a live execution timeline, self-contained Provider directories, and a unified credential data model. It did not include complete product assets under the current distribution standard.

## ✨ New features

- Added a Chrome-style Desktop tab strip with drag sorting, cross-window transfer, window detachment, and single-tab window movement.
- Added compound/split tabs, adjustable chat/web proportions, collapse animation, and accessible controls.
- Added local bookmarks and history pages plus agent control of visible Desktop Web tabs.
- Added a live interleaved execution timeline, message minimap, collapsed summaries, sub-agent spawn cards, and branch-version switching.
- Added self-contained `provider.json` and `catalog.json` directories for 22 Providers plus custom Provider management.
- Added the live Codex model list, Fast capability detection, and model-selection persistence.
- Added unified `CredentialData`, an alias-aware credential pool, and credential migration commands.
- Added categorized `/context` token details, tool/MCP statistics, and a floating context panel.

## 🐞 Bug fixes

- Fixed partial commits, failed rollback, and concurrent state inconsistencies during cross-window tab transfer.
- Fixed UI state synchronization for session switching, streaming timelines, branch retries, and edit-and-rerun.
- Fixed Provider configuration migration, base URL overrides, and model-capability persistence.
- Fixed installer behavior in non-interactive, proxy, and Windows smoke-test environments.

## 🚀 Improvements

- Implemented Desktop tab transfer with a journal and rollback-capable transaction.
- Updated installation, Provider, Desktop, Context, and development documentation.
- Included 126 commits since `v0.5.0`.

## 📦 Availability

This historical version did not provide complete product assets under the current standard. Its old installer and source are retained for historical reproduction and are not the current ordinary-user installation path. Install the [latest stable Release](https://github.com/Fzkuji/OpenProgram/releases/latest).
